original: 1.25.30 |  athātreyasya bhavagato vacanamanuniśamya punareva vāmakaḥ kāśipatiruvāca bhagavantamātreyaṃ bhagavan saṃpannimittajasya puruṣasya vipannimittajānāṃ ca rogāṇaṃ kimabhivṛddhikāraṇamiti ||

original: 1.25.31 |  tamuvāca bhagavānātreyaḥ hitāhāropayoga eka eva puruṣavṛddhikaro bhavati ahitāhāropayogaḥ punarvyādhinimittamiti ||
analyzed: tam uvāca bhagavān ātreyaḥ hita āhāra upayogaḥ ekaḥ eva puruṣa vṛddhi karaḥ bhavati ahita āhāra upayogaḥ punar vyādhi nimittam iti

original: 1.25.32 |  evaṃvādinaṃ bhagavantamātreyamagniveśa uvāca kathamiha bhagavan hitāhiānāmāhārajātānāṃ lakṣaṇamanapavādamabhijānīmahe hitasamākhyātānāmāhārajātānāmahitasamākhyātānāṃ ca mātrākālakriyābhūmidehadoṣapuruṣāvasthāntareṣu viparītakāritvamupalabhāmaha iti ||
analyzed: evaṃvādinam bhagavantam ātreyam agniveśaḥ uvāca katham iha bhagavan hita ahiānām āhāra jātānām lakṣaṇam anapavādam abhijānīmahe hita samākhyātānām āhāra jātānām ahita samākhyātānām ca mātrā kāla kriyā bhūmi deha doṣa puruṣa avasthā antareṣu viparīta kāri tvam upalabhāmahe iti

original: 1.25.33 |  tamuvāca bhagavānātreyaḥ yadāhārajātamagniveśa samāṃścaiva śarīradhātūn prakṛtau sthāpayati viṣamāṃśca samīkarotītyetaddhitaṃ viddhi viparītaṃ tvahitamiti ityetaddhitāhitalakṣaṇamanapavādaṃ bhavati ||
analyzed: tam uvāca bhagavān ātreyaḥ yat āhāra jātam agniveśa samān ca eva śarīra dhātūn prakṛtau sthāpayati viṣamān ca samīkaroti iti etat hitam viddhi viparītam tu ahitam iti iti etad hita ahita lakṣaṇam anapavādam bhavati

original: 1.25.34 |  evaṃvādinaṃ ca bhagavantamātreyamagniveśa uvāca bhagava na tvetadevamupadiṣṭaṃ bhūyiṣṭhakalpāḥ sarvabhiṣajo vijñāsyanti ||
analyzed: evaṃvādinam ca bhagavantam ātreyam agniveśaḥ uvāca bhagava na tu etat evam upadiṣṭam bhūyiṣṭha kalpāḥ sarva bhiṣajaḥ vijñāsyanti

original: 1.25.35 |  tamuvāca bhagavānātreyaḥ yeṣāṃ hi viditamāhāratattvamagniveśa guṇato dravyataḥ karmtaḥ sarvāvayavaśaśca mātrādayo bhāvāḥ ta etadevamupadiṣṭaṃ vijñātumutsahante |
analyzed: tam uvāca bhagavān ātreyaḥ yeṣām hi viditam āhāra tattvam agniveśa guṇataḥ dravyataḥ karmtaḥ sarva avayavaśas ca mātrā ādayaḥ bhāvāḥ te etat evam upadiṣṭam vijñātum utsahante

original: yathā tu khalvetadupadiṣṭaṃ bhūyiṣṭhakalpāḥ sarvabhiṣajo vijñāsyanti tathaitadupadekṣyāmo mātrādīn bhāvānanudāharantaḥ teṣāṃ hi bahuvidhavikalpā bhavanti |
analyzed: yathā tu khalu etat upadiṣṭam bhūyiṣṭha kalpāḥ sarva bhiṣajaḥ vijñāsyanti tathā etat upadekṣyāmaḥ mātra ādīn bhāvān an udāharantaḥ teṣām hi bahuvidha vikalpāḥ bhavanti
āhāra vidhi viśeṣān tu khalu lakṣaṇataḥ ca avayavataḥ ca anuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ

original: 1.25.36 |  tadyathā āhāratvamāhārasyaikavidhamarthābhedāt sa punardviyoniḥ sthāvarajaṅgamātmakatvāt dvividhaprabhāvaḥ hitāhitodarkaviśeṣāt caturvidhopayogaḥ pānāśanabhakṣyalehyopayogāt ṣaḍāsvādaḥ rasabhedataḥ ṣaḍvidhatvāt viṃśatiguṇaḥ
analyzed: tat yathā āhāra tvam āhārasya ekavidham artha abhedāt sa punar dvi yoniḥ sthāvara jaṅgama ātmaka tvāt dvividha prabhāvaḥ hita ahita udarka viśeṣāt caturvidha upayogaḥ pāna aśana bhakṣya lehya upayogāt ṣaṣ āsvādaḥ rasa bhedataḥ ṣaḍvidha tvāt viṃśati guṇaḥ
guru laghu ṣīta uṣṇa snigdha rūkṣa manda tīkṣṇa sthira sara mṛdu kaṭhina viśada picchila ślakṣṇa khara sūkṣma sthūla sāndra drava anugamāt aparisaṃkhyeya vikalpaḥ dravya saṃyoga karaṇa bāhulyāt

original: 1.25.37 |  tasya khalu ye ye vikārāvayavā bhūyiṣṭhamupayujyante bhūyiṣṭhakalpānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ prakṛtyaiva hitatamāścāhitatamāśca tāṃstān yathāvadupadekṣyāmaḥ ||
analyzed: tasya khalu ye ye vikāra avayavāḥ bhūyiṣṭham upayujyante bhūyiṣṭha kalpānām ca manuṣyāṇām prakṛtyā eva hitatamāḥ ca ahitatamāḥ ca tān tān yathāvat upadekṣyāmaḥ

original: 1.25.38 |  tadyathā lohitaśālayaḥ śūkadhānyānāṃ pathyatamatve śreṣṭhatamā bhavanti mudgāḥ śamīdhānyānām āntarikṣam udakānāṃ saindhavaṃ lavaṇānāṃ jīvantīśākaṃ śākānām aiṇeyaṃ mṛgamāṃsānāṃ lāvaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ godhā bileśayānāṃ rohito matsyānāṃ gavyaṃ sarpiḥ arpiṣāṃ gokṣīraṃ kṣīrāṇāṃ tilatailaṃ sthāvarajātānāṃ snehānāṃ varāhavasā ānūpamṛgavasānāṃ
analyzed: tat yathā lohita śālayaḥ śūkadhānyānām pathyatama tve śreṣṭhatamāḥ bhavanti mudgāḥ śamīdhānyānām āntarikṣam udakānām saindhavam lavaṇānām jīvantī śākam śākānām aiṇeyam mṛga māṃsānām lāvaḥ pakṣiṇām godhā bileśayānām rohitaḥ matsyānām gavyam sarpiḥ arpiṣām go kṣīram kṣīrāṇām tila tailam sthāvara jātānām snehānām varāha vasāḥ ānūpa mṛga vasānām anupāna anupāna anupāna anupāna anupāna anupāna anupāna anupā

original: culukīvasā matsyavasānāṃ pākahaṃsavasā jalacaravihaṅgavasānāṃ kukkuṭavasā viṣkiraśakunivasānāṃ ajamedaḥ śākhādamedasāṃ śṛṅgaveraṃ kandānāṃ mṛdvīkā phalānāṃ śarkarekṣuvikārāṇām,
analyzed: culukī vasā matsya vasānām pākahaṃsa vasā jalacara vihaṅga vasānām kukkuṭa vasā viṣkira śakuni vasānām aja medaḥ śākhāda medasām śṛṅgaveram kandānām mṛdvīkā phalānām śarkarā ikṣu vikārāṇām

original: iti prakṛtyaiva hitatamānām āhāravikārāṃ prādhānyato dravyāṇi vyākhyātāni bhavanti ||
analyzed: iti prakṛtyā eva hitatamānām āhāra vikārām prādhānyataḥ dravyāṇi vyākhyātāni bhavanti

original: 1.25.39 |  ahitatamān apy upadekṣyāmaḥ yavakāḥ śūkadhānyānāmapathyatamatvena prakṛṣṭatamā bhavanti māṣāḥ śamīdhānyānāṃ varṣānādeyam udakānām ūṣaraṃ lavaṇānāṃ sarṣapaśākaṃ śākānāṃ gomāṃsaṃ mṛgamāṃsānāṃ kāṇakapotaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ bheko bileśayānāṃ cilicimo matsyānām avikaṃ sarpiḥ sarpiṣām avikṣīraṃ kṣīrāṇāṃ kuskumbhasnehaḥ sthāvarasnehānāṃ mahiṣavasā
analyzed: ahitatamān api upadekṣyāmaḥ yavakāḥ śūkadhānyānām apathyatama tvena prakṛṣṭatamāḥ bhavanti māṣāḥ śamīdhānyānām varṣānādeyam udakānām ūṣaram lavaṇānām sarṣapa śākam śākānām go māṃsam mṛga māṃsānām kāṇa kapotaḥ pakṣiṇām bhekaḥ bileśayānām cilicimaḥ matsyānām avikam sarpiḥ sarpiṣām avi kṣīram kṣīrāṇām kuskumbha snehaḥ sthāvara snehānām mahiṣa vasā api sarpiḥ sarpiḥ api kṣīram kṣīrāṇām kuskum

original: ānūpamṛgavasānāṃ kumbhīravasā matsyavasānāṃ kākamadguvasā jalacaravihaṅgavasānāṃ caṭakavasā viṣkiraśakunivasānāṃ hastimedaḥ śākhādamedasāṃ nikucaṃ phalānām
analyzed: ānūpa mṛga vasānām kumbhīra vasā matsya vasānām kāka madgu vasā jalacara vihaṅga vasānām caṭaka vasāḥ viṣkira śakuni vasānām hasti medaḥ śākhāda medasām nikucam phalānām

original: ālukaṃ kandānāṃ phāṇitamikṣuvikārāṇām iti prakṛtayivāhitatamānāmāhāravikārāṇāṃ prakṛṣṭatamāni dravyāṇi vyākhyātāni bhavanti; (iti) hitāhitāvayavo vyākhyāta āhāravikārāṇām ||
analyzed: ālukam kandānām phāṇitam ikṣu vikārāṇām iti prakṛta yivā hitatamānām āhāra vikārāṇām prakṛṣṭatamāni dravyāṇi vyākhyātāni bhavanti iti hita ahita avayavaḥ vyākhyātaḥ āhāra vikārāṇām

original: 1.25.40 |  ato bhūyaḥ karmauṣadhānāṃ ca prādhānyataḥ sānubandhāni dravyāṇyanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ |
analyzed: atas bhūyas karma auṣadhānām ca prādhānyataḥ sa anubandhāni dravyāṇi anuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ

original: tadyathā annaṃ vṛttikarāṇāṃ śreṣṭham udakamāśvāsakarāṇāṃ (1surā śramaharāṇāṃ) kṣīraṃ jīvanīyānāṃ māṃsaṃ bṛṃhaṇīyānāṃ rasastarpaṇīyānāṃ lavaṇamannadravyarūcikarāṇām amlaṃ hṛdyānāṃ kukkuṭo balyānāṃ nakrareto vṛṣyāṇāṃ madhu śleṣmapittapraśamanānāṃ sarpirvātapittapraśamanānāṃ tailaṃ vātaśleṣmapraśamanānāṃ vamanaṃ śleṣmaharāṇāṃ virecanaṃ pittaharāṇāṃ
analyzed: tat yathā annam vṛtti karāṇām śreṣṭham udakam āśvāsa karāṇām surā śrama harāṇām kṣīram jīvanīyānām māṃsam bṛṃhaṇīyānām rasaḥ tarpaṇīyānām lavaṇam anna dravya rūci karāṇām amlam hṛdyānām kukkuṭaḥ balyānām nakra retaḥ vṛṣyāṇām madhu śleṣma pitta praśamanānām sarpiḥ vāta pitta praśamanānām tailam vāta śleṣma praśamanānām vamanam śleṣma harāṇām virecanam pitta harāṇām

original: bastirvātaharāṇāṃ svedo mārdavakarāṇāṃ vyāyāmaḥ sthairyakarāṇāṃ kṣāraḥ puṃstvopaghātināṃ (1tindukamanannadravyarucikarāṇām) āmaṃ kapitthamukaṇṭhyānām,
analyzed: vastiḥ vāta harāṇām svedaḥ mārdava karāṇām vyāyāmaḥ sthairya karāṇām kṣāraḥ puṃstva upaghātinām tindukam ananna dravya ruci karāṇām āmam kapittha mukaṇṭhyānām

original: āvikaṃ sarpirahṛdyānām ajākṣīraṃ śoṣaghnastanyasātmyaraktasāṃgrāhikaraktapittaprapraśamanānām avikṣīraṃ śleṣmapittajananānāṃ mahiṣīkṣīraṃ svapnajananānāṃ mandakaṃ dadhyabhiṣyandakarāṇāṃ gavedhukānnaṃ karśanīyānām uddālakānnaṃ virūkṣaṇīyānām ikṣurmūtrajananānāṃ yavāḥ purūṣajananānāṃ jāmbavaṃ vātajananānāṃ śaṣkulyaḥ śleṣmapittajananānāṃ kulatthā
analyzed: āvikam sarpiḥ ahṛdyānām ajā kṣīram śoṣa ghna stanya sātmya rakta sāṃgrāhika raktapitta prapraśamanānām avi kṣīram śleṣma pitta jananānām mahiṣī kṣīram svapna jananānām mandakam dadhi abhiṣyanda karāṇām gavedhuka annam karśanīyānām uddālaka annam virūkṣaṇīyānām ikṣuḥ mūtra jananānām yavāḥ purūṣa jananānām jāmbavam vāta jananānām śaṣkulyaḥ śleṣma pitta jananānām kulatthāḥ

original: amlapittajananānāṃ māṣāḥ śleṣmapittajananānāṃ madanaphalaṃ  vamanāsthāpanānuvāsanopayogināṃ trivṛt sukhvirecanānāṃ caturaṅgulo mṛduvirecanānāṃ snukpayastīkṣṇāvirecananāṃ,
analyzed: amla pitta jananānām māṣāḥ śleṣma pitta jananānām madana phalam vamana āsthāpana anuvāsana upayoginām trivṛt sukhvirecanānām caturaṅgulaḥ mṛdu virecanānām snuk payaḥ tīkṣṇā virecananām

original: pratyakpuṣpā śirovirecanānāṃ viḍaṅgaṃ krimighnānāṃ śiṛṣo viṣaghnānāṃ khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaghnānāṃ rāsnā vātaharāṇām āmalakaṃ vayaḥsthāpanānāṃ harītakī pathyānām eraṇḍamūlaṃ vṛṣyavātaharāṇāṃ pippalīmūlaṃ  dīpanīyapācanīyagudaśothārśaḥśūlaharāṇāṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ hikkāśvāsakāsapārśvaśūlaharāṇāṃ mustaṃ sāṃgrāhikadīpanīyapācanīyānām udīcyaṃ
analyzed: pratyakpuṣpā śirovirecanānām viḍaṅgam krimi ghnānām śiṛṣaḥ viṣa ghnānām khadiraḥ kuṣṭha ghnānām rāsnā vāta harāṇām āmalakam vayaḥsthāpanānām harītakī pathyānām eraṇḍa mūlam vṛṣya vāta harāṇām pippalī mūlam dīpanīya pācanīya guda śotha arśaḥ śūla harāṇām puṣkara mūlam hikkā śvāsa kāsa pārśva śūla harāṇām mustam sāṃgrāhika dīpanīya pācanīyānām udīcyam
nirvāapaṇa dīpanīya pācanīya chardi atīsāra harāṇām kaṭu aṅgam sāṃgrāhika rakta pitta praśamanānām amṛtā sāṃgrāhika vāta hara dīpanīya śleṣamśoṇita vibandha praśamanānām

original: ativiṣā dīpanīyapācanīyasāṃgrāhikasarvadoṣaharāṇām utpalakumudapadmakiñjalkaḥ sāṃgrāhikaraktapittapraśamanānāṃ durālabhā pittaśleṣmapraśamanānāṃ gandhapriyaṅguḥ śoṇitapittātiyogapraśamanānāṃ kuṭajatvak śleṣmapittaraktasāṃgrāhikopaśoṣaṇānāṃ kāśmaryaphalaṃ raktasāṃgrāhikaraktapittapraśamanānāṃ pṛśniparṇī sāṃgrāhikavātaharadīpanīyavṛṣyāṇāṃ
analyzed: ativiṣā dīpanīya pācanīya sāṃgrāhika sarva doṣa harāṇām utpala kumuda padma kiñjalkaḥ sāṃgrāhika rakta pitta praśamanānām durālabhā pitta śleṣma praśamanānām gandhapriyaṅguḥ śoṇita pitta atiyoga praśamanānām kuṭaja tvac śleṣma pitta rakta sāṃgrāhika upaśoṣaṇānām kāśmarya phalam rakta sāṃgrāhika rakta pitta praśamanānām pṛśniparṇī sāṃgrāhika vāta hara dīpanīya vṛṣyāṇām

original: vidārigandhā vṛsyasarvadoṣaharāṇāṃ balā sāṃgrāhikabalyavātaharāṇāṃ gokṣurako mūtrakṛcchrānilaharāṇāṃ hiṅguniryāsaśchedanīyadīpanīyānulomikavātakaphapraśamanānām,
analyzed: vidārigandhā vṛsya sarva doṣa harāṇām balā sāṃgrāhika balya vāta harāṇām gokṣurakaḥ mūtrakṛcchra anila harāṇām hiṅguniryāsaḥ chedanīya dīpanīya ānulomika vāta kapha praśamanānām

original: amlavetaso bhedanīyadīpanīyānulomikavātaśleṣmaharāṇāṃ yāvaśūkaḥ sraṃsanīyapācanīyārśoghnānāṃ takrābhyāso grahaṇīdoṣaśophārśoghṛtavyāpatpraśamanānāṃ kravyānmāṃsarasābhyāso grahaṇīdoṣaśoṣārśoghnānāṃ kṣīraghṛtābhyāso rasāyanānāṃ samaghṛtasaktuprāśābhyāso vṛsyodāvartaharānāṃ tailagaṇḍūṣābhyāso dantabalarucikarāṇāṃ candanaṃ
analyzed: amlavetasaḥ bhedanīya dīpanīya ānulomika vāta śleṣma harāṇām yāvaśūkaḥ sraṃsanīya pācanīya arśaḥ ghnānām takra abhyāsaḥ grahaṇī doṣa śopha arśaḥ ghṛta vyāpad praśamanānām kravyād māṃsa rasa abhyāsaḥ grahaṇī doṣa śoṣa arśaḥ ghnānām kṣīra ghṛta abhyāsaḥ rasāyanānām sama ghṛta saktu prāśa abhyāsaḥ vṛsya udāvarta harānām taila gaṇḍūṣa abhyāsaḥ danta bala ruci karāṇām candanam

original: durgandhaharadāhanirvāpaṇalepanānāṃ rāsnāguruṇī śītāpanayanapralepanānāṃ lāmajjakośīraṃ dāhatvagdoṣasvedāpanayanapralepanānāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ vātaharābhyaṅgopanāhopayogināṃ,
analyzed: durgandha hara dāha nirvāpaṇa lepanānām rāsnā aguruṇī śīta apanayana pralepanānām lāmajjaka uśīram dāha tvagdoṣa sveda apanayana pralepanānām kuṣṭham vāta hara abhyaṅga upanāha upayoginām

original: madhukaṃ cakṣuṣyavṛsyakeśyakaṇṭhyavarṇyavirajanīyaropaṇīyānāṃ vāyuḥ prāṇasaṃjñāpradānahetūnām agnirāmastambhaśītaśūodvepanapraśamanānāṃ jalaṃ stambhanīyānāṃ mṛdbhṛṣṭaloṣṭrinirvāpitamudakaṃ tṛṣṇācchardyatiyogapraśamanānām atimātrāśanamāmapradoṣahetūnāṃ yathāgnyabhyavahāro 'gnisandhukṣaṇānāṃ yathāsātmyaṃ ceṣṭābhyavahārau sevyānāṃ
analyzed: madhukam cakṣuṣya vṛsya keśya kaṇṭhya varṇya virajanīya ropaṇīyānām vāyuḥ prāṇa saṃjñā pradāna hetūnām agniḥ āma stambha śīta śūa udvepana praśamanānām jalam stambhanīyānām mṛd bhṛṣṭa loṣṭri nirvāpitam udakam tṛṣṇā chardi atiyoga praśamanānām atimātra aśanam āma pradoṣa hetūnām yathā agni abhyavahāraḥ gni sandhukṣaṇānām yathā sātmyam ceṣṭā abhyavahārau sevyānām

original: kālabhojanamārogyakarāṇāṃ tṛptirāhāraguṇānāṃ vegasandhāraṇamanārogyakarāṇāṃ madyaṃ saumanasyajananānām madyākṣepo dhīghṛtismṛtiharāṇāṃ gurubhojanaṃ durvipākakarāṇām,

karṇa akṣi mukha jihvā nāsā oṣṭha pāṇi pāda tala nakha lalāṭa mehanam snigdha rakta varṇam śrīmat bhrājiṣṇu rakta sārāṇām

original: sā sāratā sukhamuddhatāṃ medhāṃ manasvitvaṃ saukumāryamanatibalamakleśasahiṣṇutvamuṣṇāsahiṣṇutvaṃ cācaṣṭe||

śaṅkha lalāṭa kṛkāṭikā akṣi gaṇḍa hanu grīvā skandha udara kakṣa vakṣaḥ pāṇi pāda sandhayaḥ sthira guru śubha māṃsa upacitāḥ māṃsa sārāṇām

original: sā sāratā kṣamāṃ dhṛtimalaulyaṃ vittaṃ vidyāṃ sukhamārjavamārogyaṃ balamāyuśca dīrghamācaṣṭe||

original: 3.8.111 |  tatra sarvaiḥ sārairupetāḥ puruṣā bhavantyatibalāḥ *paramasukhayuktāḥ kleśasahāḥ sarvārambheṣvātmani jātapratyayāḥ kalyāṇābhiniveśinaḥ sthirasamāhitaśarīrāḥ susamāhitagatayaḥ sānunādasnigdhagambhīramahāsvarāḥ sukhaiśvaryavittopabhogasaṃmānabhājo mandajaraso mandavikārāḥ prāyastulyaguṇavistīrṇāpatyāścirajīvinaśca||
analyzed: tatra sarvaiḥ sāraiḥ upetāḥ puruṣāḥ bhavanti ati balāḥ parama sukha yuktāḥ kleśa sahāḥ sarva ārambheṣu ātmani jāta pratyayāḥ kalyāṇa abhiniveśinaḥ sthira samāhita śarīrāḥ su samāhita gatayaḥ sa anunāda snigdha gambhīra mahā svarāḥ sukha aiśvarya vitta upabhoga saṃmāna bhājaḥ manda jarasaḥ manda vikārāḥ prāyas tulya guṇa vistīrṇa apatyāḥ cira jīvinaḥ ca

original: tatra ye ghṛtakṣīratailamāṃsarasasātmyāḥ sarvarasasātmyāśca te balavantaḥ kleśasahāścirajīvinaśca bhavanti, rūkṣasātmyāḥ punarekarasasātmyāśca ye te prāyeṇālpabalā alpakleśasahā alpāyuṣo 'lpasādhanāśca bhavanti, vyāmiśrasātmyāstu ye te madhyabalāḥ sātmyanimittato bhavanti||
analyzed: tatra ye ghṛta kṣīra taila māṃsa rasa sātmyāḥ sarva rasa sātmyāḥ ca te balavantaḥ kleśa sahāḥ cira jīvinaḥ ca bhavanti rūkṣa sātmyāḥ punar eka rasa sātmyāḥ ca ye te prāyeṇa alpa balāḥ alpa kleśa sahāḥ alpa āyuṣaḥ lpa sādhanāḥ ca bhavanti vyāmiśra sātmyāḥ tu ye te madhya balāḥ sātmya nimittataḥ bhavanti
sattvataḥ ca iti sattvam ucyate manaḥ
tat śarīrasya tantrakam ātma saṃyogāt

original: tantrividhaṃ balabhedena---pravaraṃ, madhyam, avaraṃ ceti; ataśca pravaramadhyāvarasattvāḥ puruṣā bhavanti|
analyzed: tat trividham bala bhedena pravaram madhyam avaram ca iti atas ca pravara madhya avara sattvāḥ puruṣāḥ bhavanti

original: tatra pravarasattvāḥ sattvasārāste sāreṣūpadiṣṭāḥ, svalpaśarīrā hyapi te nijāgantunimittāsu mahatīṣvapi *pīḍāsvavyathā dṛśyante sattvaguṇavaiśeṣyāt; madhyasattvāstva-*parānātmanyupanidhāya saṃstambhayantyātmanā++ātmānaṃ parairvā 'pi saṃstabhyante;
analyzed: tatra pravara sattvāḥ sattva sārāḥ te sāreṣu upadiṣṭāḥ su alpa śarīrāḥ hi api te nija āgantu nimittāsu mahatīṣu api pīḍāsu avyathāḥ dṛśyante sattva guṇa vaiśeṣyāt madhya sattvāḥ tu aparān ātmani upanidhāya saṃstambhayanti ātmanā ātmānam paraiḥ vā pi saṃstabhyante

original: hīnasattvāstu nātmanā nāpi paraiḥ sattvabalaṃ prati śakyante upastambhayituṃ, mahāśarīrā hyapi te svalpānāmapi vedanānāmasahā dṛśyante, sannihitabhayaśokalobhamohamānā raudrabhairadviṣṭabībhatsavikṛtasaṃkathāsvapi ca paśupuruṣamāṃsaśoṇitāni cāvekṣya viṣādavaivarṇyamūrcchonmādabhramaprapatanānāmanyatamamāpnuvantyathavā maraṇamiti||
analyzed: hīna sattvāḥ tu na ātmanā nā api paraiḥ sattva balam prati śakyante upastambhayitum mahā śarīrāḥ hi api te su alpānām api vedanānām asahāḥ dṛśyante sannihita bhaya śoka lobha moha mānāḥ raudra bhaira dviṣṭa bībhatsa vikṛta saṃkathāsu api ca paśu puruṣa māṃsa śoṇitāni ca avekṣya viṣāda vaivarṇya mūrcchā unmāda bhrama prapatanānām anyatamam āpnuvanti athavā maraṇam iti

original: 3.8.120 |  āhāraśaktitaśceti āhāraśaktirabhyavaharaṇaśaktyā jaraṇaśaktyā ca parīkṣyā; balāyuṣī hyāhārāyatte||
analyzed: āhāra śaktitaḥ ca iti āhāra śaktiḥ abhyavaharaṇa śaktyā jaraṇa śaktyā ca parīkṣyā bala āyuṣī hi āhāra āyatte
vyāyāma śaktitaḥ ca iti vyāyāma śaktiḥ api karma śaktyā parīkṣyā
karma śaktyā hi anumīyate bala traividhyam
vayastaḥ ca iti kāla pramāṇa viśeṣa apekṣiṇī hi śarīra avasthā vayaḥ abhidhīyate
tat vayaḥ yathā sthūla bhedena trividham bālam madhyam jīrṇam iti

original: tatra bālamaparipakvadhātumajātavyañjanaṃ sukumāramakleśasahamasaṃpūrṇabalaṃ śleṣmadhātuprāyamāṣoḍaśavarṣaṃ, vivardhamānadhātuguṇaṃ punaḥ prāyeṇānavasthitasattvamātriṃśadvarṣamupadiṣṭaṃ;
analyzed: tatra bālam aparipakva dhātum ajāta vyañjanam sukumāram akleśa saham asaṃpūrṇa balam śleṣma dhātu prāyam ā ṣoḍaśa varṣam vivardhamāna dhātu guṇam punar prāyeṇa anavasthita sattvam ā triṃśat varṣam upadiṣṭam

madhyam punar samatva āgata bala vīrya pauruṣa parākrama grahaṇa dhāraṇa smaraṇa vacana vijñāna sarva dhātu guṇam bala sthitam avasthita sattvam a viśīryamāṇa dhātu guṇam pitta dhātu prāyam āṣaṣṭi varṣam upadiṣṭam

original: ataḥ paraṃ hīyamānadhātvindriyabalavīryapauruṣaparākramagrahaṇadhāraṇasmaraṇavacanavijñānaṃ bhraśyamānadhātuguṇaṃ vāyudhātuprāyaṃ krameṇa jīrṇamucyate āvarṣaśatam|
analyzed: atas param hīyamāna dhātu indriya bala vīrya pauruṣa parākrama grahaṇa dhāraṇa smaraṇa vacana vijñānam bhraśyamāna dhātu guṇam vāyu dhātu prāyam krameṇa jīrṇam ucyate ā varṣa śatam

original: varṣaśataṃ khalvāyuṣaḥ pramāṇamasmin kāle; santi ca punaradhikonavarṣaśatajīvino 'pi manuṣyāḥ; teṣāṃ vikṛtivarjyaiḥ prakṛtyādibalaviśeṣairāyuṣo lakṣaṇataśca pramāṇamupalabhya vayasastritvaṃ vibhajet||
analyzed: varṣa śatam khalu āyuṣaḥ pramāṇam asmin kāle santi ca punar manuṣyāḥ teṣām vikṛti varjyaiḥ prakṛti ādi bala viśeṣaiḥ āyuṣaḥ lakṣaṇataḥ ca pramāṇam upalabhya vayasaḥ tritvam vibhajet

original: 3.8.123 |  evaṃ prakṛtyādīnāṃ vikṛtivarjyānāṃ bhāvānāṃ pravaramadhyāvaravibhāgena balaviśeṣaṃ vibhajet|
analyzed: evam prakṛti ādīnām vikṛti varjyānām bhāvānām pravara madhya avara vibhāgena bala viśeṣam vibhajet

original: tato bhaiṣajyasya tīkṣṇamṛdumadhyavibhāgena traividhyaṃ vibhajya yathādoṣaṃ bhaiṣajyamavacārayediti||

original: 3.8.124 |  āyuṣaḥ pramāṇajñānahetoḥ punar-*indriyeṣu jātisūtrīye ca lakṣaṇānyupadekṣyante||

analyzed: tatra saṃvatsaraḥ dvidhā tridhā ṣoḍhā dvādaśadhā bhūyas ca api atas pravibhajyate tad tad kāryam abhisamīkṣya

original: atra khalu tāvat ṣoḍhā pravibhajya kāryamupadekṣyate-hemanto grīṣmo varṣāśceti śītoṣṇavarṣalakṣaṇāstraya ṛtavo bhavanti, teṣāmantarreṣvitare sādhāraṇalakṣaṇāstraya ṛtavaḥ-prāvṛṭśaradvasantā iti|
analyzed: atra khalu tāvat ṣoḍhā pravibhajya kāryam upadekṣyate hemantaḥ grīṣmaḥ varṣāḥ ca iti śīta uṣṇa varṣa lakṣaṇāḥ trayaḥ ṛtavaḥ bhavanti teṣām antar reṣu itare sādhāraṇa lakṣaṇāḥ trayaḥ ṛtavaḥ prāvṛṣ śarad vasantāḥ iti

original: syurupakramā yathā ye yatra yojyāḥ śṛṇu tathā tān||

original: śītaiḥ skandati tasmin skanne vyapayāti viṣavegaḥ||

original: 6.23.45 |  tvaṅmāṃsagataṃ dāho dahati viṣaṃ srāvaṇaṃ harati raktāt|

pītam vamanaiḥ sadyas haret virekaiḥ dvitīye tu
ādau hṛdayam rakṣyam tasya āvaraṇam pibet yathālābham

ikṣum supakvam athavā kākam niṣpīḍya tad rasam varaṇam
chāga ādīnām vā sṛj bhasma mṛdam vā pibet āśu
kṣāra agadaḥ tṛtīye śopha haraiḥ lekhanam sa madhu ambu
gomaya rasaḥ caturthe vege sa kapittha madhu sarpiḥ
kākāṇḍa śirīṣābhyām svarasena āścyotana añjane nasyam

go pitta yutā rajanī mañjiṣṭhā marica pippalī pānam

go pitta yutaiḥ guṭikāḥ surasā granthi dvi rajanī madhuka kuṣṭhaiḥ
śastā mṛtena tulyā śirīṣa puṣpaka akāṇḍaka rasaiḥ vā

śampāka lodhra mayūraka gandhaphala nākulī viḍaṅgāḥ ca

iti gandhahastī nāmā gadaḥ
pattra aguru mustā elāḥ niryāsāḥ pañca candanam spṛkkā
tvac nalada utpala bālaka hareṇuka uśīra vanya nakhāḥ
suradāru kanaka kuṅkuma dhyāmaka kuṣṭha priyaṅgavaḥ tagaram
pañcāṅgāni śurīṣāt vyoṣa āla manaḥśilā ajājyaḥ

dvija harṣa hanu stambha āsya dāha lālā gala vikārāḥ
āmāśayam praviṣṭe vaivarṇyam sveda sadanam utkledaḥ
dṛṣṭihṛdaya uparodhaḥ bindu śataiḥ cīyate ca aṅgam
pakvāśayam tu yāte mūrcchā mada moha dāha bala nāśāḥ

original: tandrā kārśyaṃ ca viṣe pāṇḍutvaṃ codarasthe syāt||
analyzed: tandrā kārśyam ca viṣe pāṇḍu tvam ca udara sthe syāt
dantapavanasya kūrcaḥ viśīryate danta oṣṭha māṃsa śophaḥ ca
keśa cyutiḥ śiraḥ ruj granthayaḥ ca sa viṣe śiraḥ abhyaṅge
duṣṭe ñjane kṣi dāha srāva ati upadeha śotha rāgāḥ ca
kha ādyaiḥ ādau koṣṭhaḥ spṛśyaiḥ tvac dūṣyate duṣṭaiḥ
snāna abhyaṅga utsādana vastra alaṅkāra varṇakaiḥ duṣṭaiḥ
kaṇḍū arti koṭha piḍakā roma udgama cimicimā śothāḥ
ete kara caraṇa dāha toda klama avipākāḥ ca
bhū pādukā aśva gaja varma ketu śayana āsanaiḥ duṣṭaiḥ
mālyam agandham mlāyati śiraḥ rujā loma harṣa karam

original: stambhayati khāni nāsāmupahanti darśanaṃ ca dhūmaḥ||
analyzed: stambhayati khāni nāsām upahanti darśanam ca dhūmaḥ
kūpa taḍāga ādi jalam durgandham sa kaluṣam vivarṇam ca

original: pītaṃ śvayathuṃ koṭhān piḍakāśca karoti maraṇaṃ ca||
analyzed: pītam śvayathum koṭhān piḍakāḥ ca karoti maraṇam ca
ādau āmāśaya ge vamanam tvac sthe pradeha seka ādi

original: kuryādbhiṣak cikitsāṃ doṣabalaṃ caiva hi samīkṣya||
analyzed: kuryāt bhiṣak cikitsām doṣa balam ca eva hi samīkṣya
iti mūla viṣa viśeṣāḥ proktāḥ śṛṇu jaṅgamasya atas
sa viśeṣa cikitsitam eva ādau tatra ucyate tu sarpāṇām
iha darvīkaraḥ sarpaḥ maṇḍalī rājimān iti
trayaḥ yathākramam vāta pitta śleṣma prakopaṇāḥ
darvīkaraḥ paṇī jñeyaḥ maṇḍalī maṇḍalā phaṇaḥ
bindu lekha vicitra aṅgaḥ pannagaḥ syāt tu rājimān
viśeṣāt rūkṣa kaṭukam amla uṣṇam svādu śītalam
viṣam yathākramam teṣām tasmāt vāta ādi kopanam
darvīkara kṛtaḥ daṃśaḥ sūkṣma daṃṣṭra padaḥ sitaḥ
pṛthu arpitaḥ sa śothaḥ ca daṃśaḥ maṇḍalinā kṛtaḥ
pīta ābhaḥ pīta raktaḥ ca sarva pitta vikāra kṛt
kṛtaḥ rājimatā daṃśaḥ picchilaḥ sthira śopha kṛt
snigdhaḥ pāṇḍuḥ ca sāndra asṛk śleṣma vyādhi samīraṇaḥ
vṛtta bhogaḥ mahā kāyaḥ śvasan ūrdhva īkṣaṇaḥ pumān
sthūla mūrdhā sama aṅgaḥ ca strī tu atas syāt viparyayāt
klībaḥ trasati adhas dṛṣṭiḥ svara hīnaḥ prakampate

original: striyā daṣṭo viparyastairetaiḥ puṃsā naro mataḥ||
analyzed: striyā daṣṭaḥ viparyastaiḥ etaiḥ puṃsā naraḥ mataḥ
vyāmiśra liṅgaiḥ etaiḥ tu klība daṣṭam naram vadet
iti etat uktam sarpāṇām strī pum klība nidarśanam
pāṇḍu vaktraḥ tu garbhiṇyā śūna oṣṭhaḥ pi asita īkṣaṇaḥ
jṛmbhā krodha upajihvā ārtaḥ sūtayā rakta mūtravān
sarpaḥ gaudherayakaḥ nāma godhāyām syāt catuṣpadaḥ
kṛṣṇasarpeṇa tulyaḥ syāt nānā syuḥ miśra jātayaḥ
gūḍha saṃpāditam vṛttam pīḍitam lambita arpitam

original: sarpitaṃ ca bhṛśābādhaṃ, daṃśā ye 'nye na te bhṛśāḥ||
analyzed: sarpitam ca bhṛśa ābādham daṃśāḥ ye nye na te bhṛśāḥ
taruṇāḥ kṛṣṇasarpāḥ tu gonasāḥ sthavirāḥ tathā
rājimantaḥ vayaḥ madhye bhavanti āśīviṣa upamāḥ
sarpa daṃṣṭrāḥ catasraḥ tu tāsām vāma adharā sitā
pītā vāma uttarā daṃṣṭrā rakta śyāvā dharā uttarā
yad mātraḥ patate binduḥ go bālāt salila uddhṛtāt
vāma adharāyām daṃṣṭṛāyām tad mātram syāt daheḥ viṣam
eka dvi tri catur vṛddha viṣa bhāga uttarottarāḥ
sa varṇāḥ tad kṛtāḥ daṃśāḥ bahu uttara viṣāḥ bhṛśāḥ
viṣ mūtrāt kīṭāḥ syuḥ kīṭa saṃmatāḥ
dūṣīviṣāḥ prāṇa harāḥ iti saṃkṣepataḥ matāḥ

original: 6.23.141 |  gātraṃ raktaṃ sitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śyāvaṃ vā piḍakānvitam|
analyzed: gātram raktam sitam kṛṣṇam śyāvam vā piḍaka anvitam
sa kaṇḍū dāha vīsarpa pāki syāt kuthitam tathā
kīṭaiḥ dūṣīviṣaiḥ daṣṭam liṅgam prāṇa haram śṛṇu
sarpa daṣṭe yathā śothaḥ vardhate sa ugra gandhi asṛk
mūrcchā sa ruj ārtaḥ śvasiti api
tṛṣṇā aruci parītaḥ ca bhavet dūṣīviṣa arditaḥ

original: 6.23.144 |  daṃśasya madhye yat kṛṣṇaṃ śyāvaṃ vā jālakāvṛtam|
analyzed: daṃśasya madhye yat kṛṣṇam śyāvam vā jālaka āvṛtam
dagdha ākṛti bhṛśam pāki kleda śotha jvara anvitam
dūṣīviṣābhiḥ lūtābhiḥ tam daṣṭam iti nirdiśet

original: 6.23.146 |  śophaḥ śvetāsitā raktāḥ pītā vā piḍakā jvaraḥ|
analyzed: śophaḥ śveta asitāḥ raktāḥ pītāḥ vā piḍakāḥ jvaraḥ
prāṇāntikaḥ bhavet śvāsaḥ dāha hikkā śirograhāḥ
ādaṃśāt śoṇitam pāṇḍu maṇḍalāni jvaraḥ ruciḥ
loma harṣaḥ ca dāhaḥ ca api ākhu dūṣīviṣa ardite
mūrcchā aṅga śotha vaivarṇya kleda śabda aśruti jvarāḥ
śiraḥ guru tvam lālā asṛj chardiḥ ca asādhya mūṣikaiḥ
śyāva tvam atha kārṣṇyam vā nānā varṇa tvam eva vā
mohaḥ purīṣa bhedaḥ ca daṣṭe syāt kṛkalāsakaiḥ
dahati agniḥ iva ādau tu bhinatti iva ūrdhvam āśu ca

original: vṛścikasya viṣaṃ yāti daṃśe paścāttu tiṣṭhati||
analyzed: vṛścikasya viṣam yāti daṃśe paścāt tu tiṣṭhati
daṣṭaḥ sādhyaḥ tu dṛś ghrāṇa rasanā upahataḥ naraḥ
māṃsaiḥ patadbhiḥ atyartham vedanā ārtaḥ jahāti asūn
visarpaḥ śvayathuḥ śūlam jvaraḥ chardiḥ atha api ca
lakṣṇam kaṇabhaiḥ daṣṭe daṃśaḥ ca eva viśīryate
stabdha liṅgaḥ bhṛśa ārtimān
daṣṭaḥ śīta udakena iva siktāni aṅgāni manyate

original: 6.23.154 |  ekadaṃṣṭrārditaḥ śūnaḥ saruk syāt pītakaḥ satṛṭ|
analyzed: eka daṃṣṭra arditaḥ śūnaḥ sa ruj syāt pītakaḥ sa tṛṣ
chardiḥ nidrā ca maṇḍūkaiḥ sa viṣaiḥ daṣṭa lakṣaṇam

original: kaṇḍūṃ śothaṃ jvaraṃ mūrcchāṃ saviṣāstu jalaukasaḥ||
analyzed: kaṇḍūm śotham jvaram mūrcchām sa viṣāḥ tu jalaukasaḥ
dāha toda sveda śotha karī tu gṛhagodhikā
daṃśe svedam rujam dāham kuryāt śatapadī viṣam
kaṇḍūmān maśakaiḥ īṣat śothaḥ syāt manda vedanaḥ
asādhya kīṭa sadṛśam asādhyam aśaka kṣatam
sadyas prasrāviṇī śyāvā dāha mūrcchā jvara anvitā
pīḍakā makṣikā daṃśe tāsām tu sthagikā suhṛd
śmaśāna citya valmīka yajña āśrama surālaye
pakṣa sandhiṣu madhyāhne sa ardharātre ṣṭamīṣu ca

original: 6.23.160 |  na siddhyanti narā daṣṭāḥ pāṣaṇḍāyataneṣu ca|
analyzed: na narāḥ daṣṭāḥ pāṣaṇḍa āyataneṣu ca

original: (yena kenāpi sarpeṇa saṃbhavaḥ sarva eva ca)||
analyzed: yena kena api sarpeṇa saṃbhavaḥ sarvaḥ eva ca
bhīta matta abala uṣṇa kṣudh tṛṣā ārte vardhate viṣam
viṣam prakṛti kālau ca tulyau prāpya alpam anyathā
vāri viprahatāḥ kṣīṇāḥ bhītāḥ nakula nirjitāḥ

original: vṛddhā bālāstvaco muktāḥ sarpā mandaviṣāḥ smṛtāḥ||
analyzed: vṛddhāḥ bālāḥ tvacaḥ muktāḥ sarpāḥ manda viṣāḥ smṛtāḥ

original: 6.23.166 |  yasya yasya hi doṣasya liṅgādhikyāni lakṣayet|
analyzed: yasya yasya hi doṣasya liṅga ādhikyāni lakṣayet
tasya tasya auṣadhaiḥ kuryāt viparīta guṇaiḥ kriyām
stambhaḥ sthi parva ruj
ghūrṇana udveṣṭanam gātra śyāva tā vātike viṣe
saṃjñā nāśa uṣṇa niśvāsau hṛd dāhaḥ kaṭuka āsya tā
daṃśa avadaraṇam śothaḥ rakta pītaḥ ca paittike
vami arocaka hṛllāsa praseka utkleśa gauravaiḥ

viṣeṣu api ca sarveṣu sarva sthāna gateṣu ca
a vṛścika ucciṭiṅgeṣu prāyas śītaḥ vidhiḥ hitaḥ

original: sekāṃścoṣṇān prayuñjīta bhojyaṃ pānaṃ ca sarpiṣaḥ||
analyzed: sekān ca uṣṇān prayuñjīta bhojyam pānam ca sarpiṣaḥ
etat eva ucciṭiṅge pi pratilomam ca pāṃśubhiḥ

anye pi evaṃvidhāḥ vyālāḥ kapha vāta prakopaṇāḥ
hṛd śiraḥ ruj jvara stambha tṛṣā mūrcchā karāḥ matāḥ

original: jvaraśca saviṣe liṅgaṃ viparītaṃ tu nirviṣe||

original: 6.23.186 |  raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca godhāyāḥ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ hitam|

original: 6.23.205 |  tvacaṃ ca nāgaraṃ caiva samāṃśaṃ ślakṣṇapeṣitam|

jīrṇam sarpiḥ tathā tailam tila sarṣapa jam hitam

original: 6.30.72 |  vartiḥ kṛtā muhurdhāryā tataḥ secyā sukhāmbunā|

original: 6.30.78 |  tailaṃ kvāthena tasyaiva siddhaṃ dhāryaṃ ca pūrvavat|

original: tilacūrṇaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ phāṇitaṃ śaukarī vasā||

pāṭhā jambu āmrayoḥ madhyam śilodbhedam rasāñjanam

iti puṣya anuga cūrṇam
tu

original: 6.30.97 |  rasāñjanaṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca chāgena payasā pibet|

original: 6.30.102 |  arajaskā pibet siddhaṃ jīvanīyaiḥ payo 'pi vā|
analyzed: arajaskā pibet siddham jīvanīyaiḥ payaḥ vā

nahi vātāt ṛte yoniḥ nārīṇām saṃpraduṣyati

śoṣayanti āśu tad nāśāt retaḥ ca api upahanyate
tatra saṃpūrṇa sarva aṅgaḥ sa bhavati apumān pumān
ete tu asādhyāḥ vyākhyātāḥ sannipāta samucchrayāt
cikitsitam atas tu ūrdhvam samāsa vyāsataḥ śṛṇu
śukra doṣeṣu nirdiṣṭam bheṣajam yat mayā nagha
klaibya upaśāntaye kuryāt kṣīṇa kṣata hitam ca yat
vastayaḥ kṣīra sarpīṃṣi vṛṣya yogāḥ ca ye matāḥ
rasāyana prayogāḥ ca sarvān etān prayojayet
samīkṣya deha doṣa agni balam bheṣaja kāla vid
vyavāya hetu je klaibye tathā dhātu viparyayāt
daiva vyapāśrayam ca eva bheṣajam ca abhicāra je
samāsena etat uddiṣṭam bheṣajam klaibya śāntaye
vistareṇa pravakṣyāmi klaibyānām bheṣajam punar
susvinna snigdha gātrasya sneha yuktam virecanam
anna aśanam tatas kuryāt athavā āsthāpanam punar
pradadyāt matimān vaidyaḥ tatas tam anuvāsayet
palāśa eraṇḍa mustā ādyaiḥ paścāt āsthāpayet tatas
vājīkaraṇa yogāḥ ca pūrvam ye samudāhṛtāḥ

original: 6.30.199 |  bhiṣajā te prayojyāḥ syuḥ klaibye bījopaghātaje|
analyzed: bhiṣajā te prayojyāḥ syuḥ klaibye bīja upaghāta je
dhvaja bhaṅga kṛtam klaibyam jñātvā tasya ācaret kriyām
pradehān pariṣekān ca kuryāt vā raktamokṣaṇam

original: snehapānaṃ ca kurvīta sasnehaṃ ca virecanam||
analyzed: sneha pānam ca kurvīta sa sneham ca virecanam
anuvāsam tatas kuryāt athavā āsthāpanam punar
vraṇa vat ca kriyāḥ sarvāḥ tatra kuryāt vicakṣaṇaḥ
jarā saṃbhava je klaibye kṣaya je ca eva kārayet
sneha sveda upapannasya sa sneham śodhanam hitam
kṣīra sarpiḥ vṛṣya yogāḥ vastayaḥ ca eva yāpanāḥ
rasāyana prayogāḥ ca tayoḥ bheṣajam ucyate
vistareṇa etat uddiṣṭam klaibyānām bheṣajam mayā

original: yaḥ pūrvamuktaḥ pradaraḥ śṛṇu hetvādibhistu tam||
analyzed: yaḥ pūrvam uktaḥ pradaraḥ śṛṇu hetu ādibhiḥ tu tam
yā tyartham sevate nārī lavaṇa amla gurūṇi ca
kaṭūni atha vidāhīni snigdhāni piśitāni ca
grāmyaudakāni medyāni kṛsarām pāyasam dadhi
śukra mastu surā ādīni bhajantyāḥ kupitaḥ nilaḥ
raktam pramāṇam utkramya garbhāśaya gatāḥ sirāḥ
rajaḥ vahāḥ samāśritya raktam ādāya tad rajaḥ
yasmāt vivardhayati āśu rasa bhāvāt vimāna tā
tasmāt asṛgdaram prāhuḥ etat tantra viśāradāḥ

original: 6.30.209 |  rajaḥ pradīryate yasmāt pradarastena sa smṛtaḥ|
analyzed: rajaḥ pradīryate yasmāt pradaraḥ tena sa smṛtaḥ
sāmānyatas samuddiṣṭam kāraṇam liṅgam eva ca
caturvidham vyāsataḥ tu vāta ādyaiḥ sannipātataḥ
atas param pravakṣyāmi hetu ākṛti bhiṣagjitam
rūkṣa ādibhiḥ mārutaḥ tu raktam ādāya pūrvavat

original: kupitaḥ pradaraṃ kuryāllakṣaṇaṃ tasya me śṛṇu||
analyzed: kupitaḥ pradaram kuryāt lakṣaṇam tasya me śṛṇu

original: 6.30.212 |  phenilaṃ tanu rūkṣaṃ ca śyāvaṃ cāruṇameva ca|
analyzed: phenilam tanu rūkṣam ca śyāvam ca aruṇam eva ca
kiṃśuka udaka saṅkāśam sa rujam vā nīrujam
kaṭi vaṅkṣaṇa hṛd pārśva pṛṣṭha śroṇiṣu mārutaḥ
kurute vedanām tīvrām etat vāta ātmakam viduḥ
amla uṣṇa lavaṇa kṣāraiḥ pittam prakupitam yadā

original: pūrvavat pradaraṃ kuryāt paittikaṃ liṅgataḥ śṛṇu||
analyzed: pūrvavat pradaram kuryāt paittikam liṅgataḥ śṛṇu
sa nīlam athavā pītam ati uṣṇam asitam tathā
nitānta raktam sravati muhur muhur atha ārtimat
dāha rāga tṛṣā moha jvara bhrama samāyutam
asṛgdaram paittikam syāt ślaibmikam tu pravakṣyate
guru ādibhiḥ hetubhiḥ ca pūrvavat kupitaḥ kaphaḥ

original: pradaraṃ kurute tasya lakṣaṇaṃ tattvataḥ śṛṇu||
analyzed: pradaram kurute tasya lakṣaṇam tattvataḥ śṛṇu

original: 6.30.218 |  picchilaṃ pāṇḍuvarṇaṃ caguru snigdhaṃ ca śītalam|
analyzed: picchilam pāṇḍu varṇam ca guru snigdham ca śītalam
sravati asṛk śleṣmalam ca ghanam manda rujā karam
chardi arocaka hṛllāsa śvāsa kāsa samanvitam
vakṣyate kṣīra doṣāṇām sāmānyam iha kāraṇam
yat tat eva tridoṣasya kāraṇam pradarasya tu
tri liṅga saṃyutam vidyāt na eka avastham asṛgdaram
nārī tu ati parikliṣṭā yadā prakṣīṇa śoṇitā
sarva hetu samācārāt ativṛddhaḥ tadā nilaḥ
rakta mārgeṇa sṛjati pratyanīka balam kapham
durgandham picchilam pītam vidagdham pitta tejasā
vasām medaḥ ca yāvat hi samupādāya vegavān
sṛjati apatya mārgeṇa sarpiḥ majja vasā upamam
śaśvat sravati atha āsrāvam tṛṣṇā dāha jvara anvitām
kṣīṇa raktām durbalām sa tām asādhyām vivarjayet
māsān niṣpiccha dāha ārti pañca rātra anubandhi ca
na eva ati bahu na ati alpam ārtavam śuddham ādiśet
guñjā phala savarṇam ca padma alaktaka sannibham
indragopaka saṅkāśam ārtavam śuddham ādiśet
yonīnām vātala ādyānām yat uktam iha bheṣajam

original: caturṇāṃ pradarāṇāṃ ca tat sarvaṃ kārayedbhiṣak||
analyzed: caturṇām pradarāṇām ca tat sarvam kārayet bhiṣak
rakta tisāriṇām yat ca tathā śoṇitapittinām

original: raktārśasāṃ ca yat proktaṃ bheṣajaṃ tacca kārayet||
analyzed: rakta arśasām ca yat proktam bheṣajam tat ca kārayet
dhātrī stana stanya saṃpad uktā vistarataḥ purā
stanya saṃjananam ca eva stanyasya ca viśodhanam

original: 6.30.230 |  vātādiduṣṭe liṅgaṃ ca kṣīṇasya ca cikitsitam|
analyzed: vāta ādi duṣṭe liṅgam ca kṣīṇasya ca cikitsitam
tat sarvam uktam ye tu aṣṭau kṣīra doṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
vāta ādiṣu eva tān vidyāt śāstra cakṣuḥ bhiṣaktamaḥ
trividhāḥ tu yatas śiṣyāḥ tatas vakṣyāmi vistaram
ajīrṇa asātmya viṣama viruddha atyartha bhojanāt
lavaṇa amla kaṭu kṣāra praklinnānām ca sevanāt
manaḥ śarīra saṃtāpāt asvapnāt niśi cintanāt
prāpta vega pratīghātāt aprāpta udīraṇena ca
paramānnam guḍa kṛtam kṛsarām dadhi mandakam
abhiṣyandīni māṃsāni grāmya ānūpa audakāni ca
bhuktvā bhuktvā divāsvapnāt madyasya ati niṣevaṇāt
anāyāsāt abhīghātāt krodhāt ca ātaṅka karśanaiḥ

original: 6.30.236 |  doṣāḥ kṣīravahāḥ prāpya sirāḥ stanyaṃ pradūṣya ca|
analyzed: doṣāḥ kṣīra vahāḥ prāpya sirāḥ stanyam pradūṣya ca
kuryuḥ aṣṭavidham bhūyas doṣataḥ tat nibodha me
vairasyam phena saṅghātaḥ raukṣyam ca iti anila ātmake
pittāt vaivarṇya daurgandhye sneha paicchilya gauravam
kaphāt bhavati rūkṣa ādyaiḥ anilaḥ svaiḥ prakopaṇaiḥ
kruddhaḥ kṣīra āśayam prāpya rasam stanyasya dūṣayet
virasam vāta saṃsṛṣṭam kṛśībhavati tat piban

original: na *cāsya svadate kṣīraṃ kṛcchreṇa ca vivardhate||
analyzed: na ca asya svadate kṣīram kṛcchreṇa ca vivardhate
tathā eva vāyuḥ kupitaḥ stanyam antar viloḍayan
karoti phena saṅghātam tat tu kṛcchrāt pravartate
tena kṣāma svaraḥ bālaḥ baddha viṣ mūtra mārutaḥ
vātikam śīrṣa rogam vā pīnasam vā dhigacchati
pūrvavat kupitaḥ stanye sneham śoṣayate nilaḥ
rūkṣam tat pibataḥ raukṣyāt bala hrāsaḥ prajāyate
pittam uṣṇa ādibhiḥ kruddham stanya āśayam abhiplutam
karoti stanya vaivarṇyam nīla pīta asita ādikam
vivarṇa gātraḥ svinnaḥ syāt tṛṣṇāluḥ bhinna viś śiśuḥ
nityam uṣṇa śarīraḥ ca na abhinandati tam stanam
pūrvavat kupite pitte daurgandhyam kṣīram ṛcchati
pāṇḍu āmayaḥ tat pibataḥ kāmalā ca bhavet śiśoḥ
kruddhaḥ guru ādibhiḥ śleṣmā kṣīrāśaya gataḥ striyāḥ
sneha anvita tvāt tat kṣīram ati snigdham karoti tu
chardanaḥ kunthanaḥ tena lālāluḥ jāyate śiśuḥ
nitya upadigdhaiḥ srotobhiḥ nidrā klama samanvitaḥ
śvāsa kāsa parītaḥ tu praseka tamaka anvitaḥ

original: abhibhūya kaphaḥ stanyaṃ picchilaṃ kurute yadā||
analyzed: abhibhūya kaphaḥ stanyam picchilam kurute yadā
lālāluḥ śūna vaktra akṣiḥ jaḍaḥ syāt tat piban śiśuḥ
kaphaḥ kṣīrāśaya gataḥ guru tvāt kṣīra gauravam
karoti guru tat pītvā bālaḥ hṛd rogam ṛcchati
anyān ca vividhān rogān kuryāt kṣīra samāśritān
kṣīre vāta ādibhiḥ duṣṭe saṃbhavanti tad ātmakāḥ
tatra ādau stanya śuddhi artham dhātrīm sneha upapāditām
saṃsvedya vidhivat vaidyaḥ vamanena upapādayet
vacā priyaṅgu yaṣṭyāhva phala vatsaka sarṣapaiḥ
kalkaiḥ nimba paṭolānām kvāthaiḥ sa lavaṇaiḥ vamet
samyak vāntām yathānyāyam kṛta saṃsarjanām tatas
doṣa kāla bala apekṣī snehayitvā virecayet
trivṛtām abhayām vā triphalā rasa saṃyutām
pāyayet madhu saṃyuktām abhayām vā kevalām
pāyayet mūtra saṃyuktām vireka artham ca śāstra vid
samyak viriktām matimān kṛta saṃsarjanām punar
tatas doṣa avaśeṣa ghnaiḥ anna pānaiḥ upācaret

original: 6.30.257 |  śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikā vā syuḥ śyāmākā bhojane hitāḥ|
analyzed: śālayaḥ ṣaṣṭikāḥ vā syuḥ śyāmākāḥ bhojane hitāḥ
priyaṅgavaḥ koradūṣāḥ yavāḥ veṇuyavāḥ tathā
vaṃśa vetra kalāyāḥ ca śāka arthe sneha saṃskṛtāḥ
mudgān masūrān yūṣa arthe kulatthān ca prakalpayet
nimba vetra agra kulaka vārtāka āmalakaiḥ śṛtān
sa vyoṣa saindhavān yūṣān dāpayet stanya śodhanān
śaśān kapiñjilān eṇān saṃskṛtān ca pradāpayet
śārṅgeṣṭā saptaparṇa tvac aśvagandhā śṛtam jalam
pāyayeta athavā stanya śuddhaye rohiṇī śṛtam
amṛtā saptaparṇa tvac kvātham ca eva sa nāgaram
kirātatiktaka kvātham ślokapāda īritān pibet
trīn etān stanya śuddhi artham iti sāmānyabheṣajam
kīrtitam stanya doṣāṇām pṛthak anyam nibodhata
pāyayet virasa kṣīrām drākṣā madhuka sārivāḥ
ślakṣṇa piṣṭām payasyām ca samāloḍya sukha ambunā
pañcakola kulatthaiḥ ca piṣṭaiḥ ālepayet stanau
śuṣkau prakṣālya nirduhyāt tathā stanyam viśudhyati
phena saṅghātavat kṣīram yasyāḥ tām pāyayet striyam
pāṭhā nāgara śārṅgeṣṭā mūrvāḥ piṣṭvā sukha ambunā
stanayoḥ pūrvavat kāryam lepanam kṣīra śodhanam
tam kvātham pāyayet dhātrīm stanya doṣa nibarhaṇam
stanau ca ālepayet piṣṭaiḥ yava godhūma sarṣapaiḥ
ṣaḍvirekāśritīya uktaiḥ auṣadhaiḥ stanya śodhanaiḥ

original: *rūkṣakṣīrā pibet kṣīraṃ tairvā siddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet||
analyzed: rūkṣa kṣīrā pibet kṣīram taiḥ vā siddham ghṛtam pibet
pūrvavat jīvaka ādyam ca pañcamūlam pralepanam
stanayoḥ saṃvidhātavyam sukha uṣṇam stanya śodhanam
yaṣṭīmadhuka mṛdvīkā payasyā sindhuvārikāḥ
śīta ambunā pibet kalkam kṣīra vaivarṇya nāśanam
drākṣā madhuka kalkena stanau ca asyāḥ pralepayet
prakṣālya vāriṇā ca eva nirduhyāt tau punar punar
viṣāṇikā ajaśṛṅgyau ca triphalām rajanīm vacām
pibet śīta ambunā piṣṭvā kṣīra daurgandhya nāśinīm
lihyāt vā pi abhayā cūrṇam sa vyoṣam mākṣika plutam
kṣīra daurgandhya nāśa artham dhātrī pathya āśinī tathā
sārivā uśīra mañjiṣṭhā śleṣmātaka kucandanaiḥ
patra ambu candana uśīraiḥ stanau ca asyāḥ pralepayet
snigdha kṣīrāḥ dāru mustā pāṭhāḥ piṣṭvā sukha ambunā
pītvā sa saindhavāḥ kṣipram kṣīra śuddhim avāpnuyāt
pāyayet picchila kṣīrām śārṅgeṣṭām abhayām vacām
mustā nāgara pāṭhāḥ ca pītāḥ stanya viśodhanāḥ
takrāriṣṭam pibet ca api yat uktam gudaja apaham
vidārī bilva madhukaiḥ stanau ca asyāḥ pralepayet
trāyamāṇā amṛtā nimba paṭola triphalā śṛtam
guru kṣīrā pibet āśu stanya doṣa viśuddhaye
pibet vā pippalī mūla cavya citraka nāgaram
balā nāgara śārṅgeṣṭā mūrvābhiḥ lepayet stanau
pṛśniparṇī payasyābhyām stanau ca asyāḥ pralepayet
aṣṭau ete kṣīra doṣāḥ hetu lakṣaṇa bheṣajaiḥ
nirdiṣṭāḥ kṣīra doṣa utthāḥ tathā uktāḥ kecid āmayāḥ
doṣa dūṣya malāḥ ca eva mahatām vyādhayaḥ ca ye

original: 6.30.283 |  ta eva *sarve bālānāṃ mātrā tvalpatarā matā|
analyzed: te eva sarve bālānām mātrā tu alpatarā matā
nivṛttiḥ vamana ādīnām mṛdu tvam paratantra tām
vāc ceṣṭayoḥ asāmarthyam vīkṣya bāleṣu śāstra vid
bheṣajam svalpa mātram tu yathāvyādhi prayojayet
madhurāṇi kaṣāyāṇi kṣīravanti mṛdūni ca
prayojayet bhiṣaj bāle matimān apramādataḥ
atyarhta snigdha rūkṣa uṣṇam amlam kaṭu vipāki ca
guru ca auṣadha pāna annam etat bāleṣu garhitam
samāsāt sarva rogāṇām etat bāleṣu bheṣajam
nirdiṣṭam śāstra vid vaidyaḥ pravivicya prayojayet
bhavanti ca atra
iti sarva vikārāṇām uktam etat cikitsitam
sthānam etat hi tantrasya rahasyam param uttamam

original: 6.30.289 |  asmin saptadaśādhyāyāḥ kalpāḥ siddhaya eva ca|
analyzed: asmin saptadaśa adhyāyāḥ kalpāḥ siddhayaḥ eva ca
na āsādyante gniveśasya tantre caraka saṃskṛte
tān etān kāpilabaliḥ śeṣān dṛḍhabalo karot
tantrasya asya mahārthasya pūraṇa artham yathātatham
rogāḥ ye pi atra na uddiṣṭāḥ bahu tvāt nāma rūpataḥ
teṣām api etat eva syāt doṣa ādīn vīkṣya bheṣajam
doṣa dūṣya nidānānām viparītam hitam dhruvam
ukta anuktān gadān sarvān samyak yuktam niyacchati
deśa kāla pramāṇānām sātmya asātmyasya ca eva hi
samyak yogaḥ nyathā hi eṣām pathyam api anyathā bhavet
āsyāt āmāśaya sthān hi rogān nastas śiraḥ gatān
gudāt pakvāśaya sthān ca hanti āśu dattam auṣadham
śarīra avayava uttheṣu visarpa piḍaka ādiṣu
yathādeśam pradeha ādi śamanam syāt viśeṣataḥ
dina ātura auṣadha vyādhi jīrṇa liṅga ṛtu avekṣaṇam
kālam vidyāt dina avekṣaḥ pūrvāhṇe yathā
rogi avekṣaḥ yathā prātar virannaḥ balavān pibet
bheṣajam laghu pathya annaiḥ yuktam adyāt tu durbalaḥ
bhaiṣajya kālaḥ bhukta ādau madhye paścāt muhur muhur
sāmudgam bhakta saṃyuktam grāsa grāsa antare daśa
apāne viguṇe pūrvam samāne madhyam bhojanam
vyāne tu prātar aśitam udāne bhojana uttaram
vāyau prāṇe praduṣṭe tu grāsa grāsa antar iṣyate
śvāsa kāsa pipāsāsu tu avacāryam muhur muhur
sāmudgam hikkine deyam laghunā nnena saṃyutam
saṃbhojyam tu auṣadham bhojyaiḥ vicitraiḥ arucau hitam
jvare peyāḥ kaṣāyāḥ ca kṣīram sarpiḥ virecanam

original: ṣaḍahe ṣAḍahe deyaṃ kālaṃ vīkṣyāmayasya ca||
analyzed: ṣaṣ ahe ṣaṣ ahe deyam kālam vīkṣya āmayasya ca
kṣudh vega mokṣau laghu tā viśuddhiḥ jīrṇa lakṣaṇam
tadā bheṣajam ādeyam syāt hi doṣa vat anyathā

original: 6.30.304 |  cayādayaśca doṣāṇāṃ varjyaṃ sevyaṃ ca yatra yat|
analyzed: caya ādayaḥ ca doṣāṇām varjyam sevyam ca yatra yat
rtau avekṣyam yat karma pūrvam sarvam udāhṛtam
upakramāṇām karaṇam pratiṣedhe ca kāraṇam
vyākhyātam abalānām sa vikalpānām avekṣaṇe
muhur muhur ca rogāṇām avasthām āturasya ca
avekṣamāṇaḥ tu bhiṣak cikitsāyām na muhyati
iti evam ṣaḍvidham kālam an avekṣya bhiṣagjitam
prayuktam ahitāya syāt sasyasya akāla varṣa vat
vyādhīnām ṛtu ahar rātra vayasām bhojanasya ca

original: viśeṣo bhidyate yastu kālāvekṣaḥ sa ucyate||
analyzed: viśeṣaḥ bhidyate yaḥ tu kāla avekṣaḥ saḥ ucyate

original: 6.30.309 |  vasante śleṣmajā rogāḥ śaratkāle tu pittajāḥ|
analyzed: vasante śleṣma jāḥ rogāḥ śarad kāle tu pitta jāḥ
varṣāsu vātikāḥ ca eva prāyas prādurbhavanti hi

original: 6.30.310 |  niśānte divasānte ca varṣānte vātajā gadāḥ|
analyzed: niśā ante divasa ante ca varṣā ante vāta jāḥ gadāḥ
prātar kṣapā ādau kapha jāḥ tayoḥ madhye tu pitta jāḥ
vayaḥ anta madhya prathame vāta pitta kapha āmayāḥ

analyzed: proktāḥ vistaraśaḥ bhinnāḥ dve śate ṣoḍaśa uttare
ete mākṣika saṃyuktāḥ kurvanti ati vṛṣam naram

original: 8.12.29 |  nātiyogaṃ na vā 'yogaṃ stambhitāste ca kurvate|
analyzed: na atiyogam na vā yogam stambhitāḥ te ca kurvate
mṛdu tvāt na nivartante yasya tu ete prayojitāḥ
sa mūtraiḥ vastibhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ āsthāpyaḥ kṣipram eva saḥ
śopha agni nāśa pāṇḍu tva śūla arśaḥ parikartikāḥ
syuḥ jvaraḥ ca atisāraḥ ca yāpana atyartha sevanāt
ariṣṭa kṣīra sīdhu ādyā tatra iṣṭā dīpanī kriyā
yuktyā tasmāt niṣeveta yāpanāt na prasaṅgataḥ
iti uccais bhāṣya pūrvāṇām vyāpadaḥ sa cikitsitāḥ
vistareṇa pṛthak proktāḥ tebhyaḥ rakṣet naram sadā
karmaṇām vamana ādīnām asamyakkaraṇa āpadām
yatra uktam sādhanam sthāne siddhisthānam tat ucyate
iti adhyāya śatam viṃśa mātreya muni vāṅgyam
hita artham prāṇinām proktam agniveśena dhīmatā
dīrgham āyuḥ yaśaḥ svāsthyam trivargam ca api puṣkalam

original: 8.12.36 |  siddhiṃ cānuttamāṃ loke prāpnoti vidhinā paṭhan|
analyzed: siddhim ca anuttamām loke prāpnoti vidhinā paṭhan
vistārayati leśa uktam saṃkṣipati ati vistaram

original: 8.12.37 |  saṃskartā kurute tantraṃ purāṇaṃ ca punarnavam|
analyzed: saṃskartā kurute tantram purāṇam ca punar navam
atas tantra uttamam idam carakeṇa ati buddhinā
saṃskṛtam tattva saṃpūrṇam tri bhāgena upalakṣyate
tat śaṅkaram bhūtapatim saṃprasādya samāpayat
akhaṇḍa artham dṛḍhabalaḥ jātaḥ pañcanade pure
kṛtvā bahubhyaḥ tantrebhyaḥ viśeṣa uñcha śiloccayam
saptadaśa auṣadha adhyāya siddhi kalpaiḥ apūrayat
idam anyūna śabda artham tantra doṣa vivarjitam
ṣaḍviṃśatā vicitrābhiḥ bhūṣitam tantra yuktibhiḥ
tatra adhikaraṇam yogaḥ hetvarthaḥ rthaḥ padasya ca
pradeśa uddeśa nirdeśa vākyaśeṣāḥ prayojanam
upadeśa apadeśa atideśa arthāpatti nirṇayāḥ
sa apavargaḥ viparyayaḥ
pūrvapakṣa vidhāna anumata vyākhyāna saṃśayāḥ
atīta anāgata avekṣā svasaṃjñā ūhya samuccayāḥ
nidarśanam nirvacanam saṃniyogaḥ vikalpanam
pratyutsāraḥ tathā uddhāraḥ saṃbhavaḥ tantra yuktayaḥ
tantre samāsa vyāsa ukte bhavanti etāḥ hi kṛtsnaśas
eka deśena dṛśyante samāsa abhihite tathā
yathā mbuja vanasya arkaḥ pradīpaḥ veśmanaḥ yathā
prabodhana prakāśa arthaḥ tathā tantrasya yuktayaḥ
ekasmin api yasya iha śāstre labdha āspadā matiḥ
sa śāstram anyat api āśu yukti jña tvāt prabudhyate
adhīyānaḥ u pi śāstrāṇi tantra yuktyā vinā bhiṣak
na adhigacchati śāstra arthān arthān bhāgya kṣaye yathā
durgṛhītam kṣiṇoti eva śāstram śastram iva abudham

original: sugṛhītaṃ tadeva jñaṃ śāstraṃ śastraṃ ca rakṣati||
analyzed: su gṛhītam tat eva jñam śāstram śastram ca rakṣati
tasmāt etāḥ pravakṣyante vistareṇa uttare punar
tattva jñāna artham asya eva tantrasya guṇa doṣataḥ
idam akhilam adhītya samyak arthān vimṛśati yaḥ vimanāḥ prayoga nityaḥ
sa manuja sukha jīvita pradātā bhavati dhṛti smṛti buddhi dharma vṛddhaḥ
yasya dvādaśasāhasrī hṛdi tiṣṭhati saṃhitā
saḥ ṛtha jñaḥ sa vicāra jñaḥ cikitsā kuśalaḥ ca saḥ

original: 8.12.53 |  rogāṃsteṣāṃ cikitsāṃ ca sa kimarthaṃ na budhyate|
analyzed: rogān teṣām cikitsām ca sa kimartham na budhyate
cikitsā vahniveśasya sustha ātura hitam prati
yat iha asti tat anyatra yat na iha asti na tat kvacid
agniveśa kṛte tantre caraka pratisaṃskṛte
siddhisthāne ṣṭame prāpte tasmin dṛḍhabalena tu
siddhisthānam sva siddhi artham samāsena samāpitam

original: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasaṃpūrite siddhisthāne uttarabastisiddhirnāma dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||12 | |
analyzed: iti agniveśa kṛte tantre caraka pratisaṃskṛte prāpte dṛḍhabala saṃpūrite siddhisthāne uttarabastisiddhiḥ nāma dvādaśaḥ dhyāyaḥ
samāptam idam caraka tantram
